visible_inputs: retrieval verdict, confidence, rationale, question answers, and one selected evidence excerpt per answered question
identity-masked memory-only repeated judgments, confidence, knowledge basis, rationales, decisive propositions, and consistency
forbidden_inputs: attack family, condition, nominal strength, or realized strength
raw URL or clean:/poison: source identifier

stage3.workflow: evidence critic followed by claim-level LLM arbiter
stage3.primary_selection_metric: attacked accuracy against max(poisoned RAG, strongest model-only ensemble)
secondary_metrics: clean accuracy delta from clean RAG
stage3.position_bias_control: swap retrieval and memory presentation blocks using a deterministic packet-key permutation

aligned_stage3.research_question: Can one model route between its own RAG and closed-book endpoints under poisoning?
aligned_stage3.primary_roles: The RAG victim, closed-book endpoint, and router use exactly the same model.
aligned_stage3.primary_model_reason: Largest frozen 1% endpoint-oracle headroom over the stronger same-model endpoint (7/44 cases).

variants.endpoint_only: One RAG verdict/rationale and that model's three cached closed-book samples; no retrieved excerpts.
variants.evidence_aware: The endpoint-only inputs plus every normalized source-neutral top-k excerpt.

aligned_stage3.prediction_contract: Copy the provisional endpoint verdict; do not synthesize a third verdict.
aligned_stage3.primary_metric: Per-model attacked accuracy against max(the same model's poisoned RAG, the same model's closed-book accuracy).

stage4.activation: Stage 3 escalate route only during the first implementation
stage4.proposition_source: derive from both endpoint rationales and the critic, not only victim-generated questions

aligned_stage4.activation: Only when the same model's RAG and closed-book endpoint verdicts disagree.
aligned_stage4.proposition_check: A fresh closed-book call to the same model sees the original claim and one neutral pivotal proposition, but no endpoint or retrieved content.
aligned_stage4.final_selection: A fresh call to the same model selects an existing endpoint; no synthesized verdict.
aligned_stage4.validation_policy: Select the A/B input variant on method-design, freeze it, then keep development-validation unopened until all prompts are locked.

aligned_stage4_v2.activation: Only when the same model's RAG and closed-book endpoint verdicts disagree, in both clean and attacked conditions.
aligned_stage4_v2.architecture: Two-proposition architect, two isolated checks per proposition, retrieval-isolated internal synthesis, and a rationale-firewalled same-model selector.
aligned_stage4_v2.control: Five additional direct end-claim judgments, retrieval-isolated synthesis, and the same firewalled selector, exactly matching seven calls per disagreement.
aligned_stage4_v2.validation_policy: At most one failure-class-driven redesign on method-design; freeze all prompts and seeds before opening development_validation.

final_candidate.status: frozen development-validation complete; original locked test unopened
final_candidate.primary_result: At Fact2Fiction 1%, 23/28 validation versus same-model memory 16/28 and poisoned RAG 21/28; clean 27/40 versus RAG 28/40.
final_candidate.generic_control: Same two-call workflow with a generic end-claim check: validation 1% 21/28 and clean 29/40.
